subject: Money
title: Volatility Monster
description: A short lesson to help you apply Volatility Monster.

hook.text: Bitcoin dropped 80% in 2018, 73% in 2022, and 85% in 2014. Each time, obituaries were written. Each time, it recovered.

buildup.text: Crypto is 5-10x more volatile than stocks. A normal month might see 20% swings. A bad month: 50% loss.

discovery.text: This volatility comes from thin liquidity, retail-dominated markets, and no fundamental valuation anchor.

twist.text: Volatility is what creates 1,000% returns. You can't have the upside without the stomach-churning downside.

climax.text: Never invest in crypto what you can't afford to lose completely. This isn't a cliché. It's happened to millions.

punchline.text: Wild gains and crushing losses. Same coin.

quiz.question: How does crypto volatility compare to stocks?
